newsitem.title: USA: Thomaston Mills sees Q1 unfavorable.
newsitem.headline: Thomaston Mills sees Q1 unfavorable.

text.p: Thomaston Mills Inc said on Thursday that results for its first quarter ended September 28 would not compare favorably with the comparable period a year earlier.
The company said that during the first quarter it processed higher-priced cotton from old crop, and retail demand for consumer products was soft.
Thomaston said it was optimistic about its performance in the second half of the fiscal year.
According to the company, new crop cotton should bring a decline in raw material prices, while intensified marketing efforts should also help.
Earlier Thursday, Thomaston reported fiscal 1996 earnings of $0.09 a share, compared with $0.52 a share the year before.
The company said its performance in the fiscal year to the end of June reflected a poor retail climate, high raw material prices and low capacity utilization.
